events.title: DOLLY: I Will Always Love You — Tribute Concert
events.description: A live tribute show celebrating the music of Dolly Parton, featuring an intimate performance at The Events Centre in Caloundra. Expect classic hits and a strong artistic atmosphere.

events.title: SunCon 2026 – Sunshine Coast Pop Culture Convention
events.datetime: Fri 5 Jun (evening) & Sat 6 Jun, 9:30 AM onwards
events.description: A fan convention celebrating pop culture, comics, cosplay, and gaming, designed as a social gathering for creative and curious individuals. Features an evening preview on Friday and main events Saturday from 9:30 AM.

events.title: Ocean Film Festival World Tour
events.description: A curated selection of films showcasing stunning ocean cinematography, featuring adventures from divers, surfers, and oceanographers. Experience underwater realms and powerful waves through these visual masterpieces.

events.title: Melbourne International Comedy Festival Roadshow
events.description: The renowned Melbourne International Comedy Festival Roadshow brings a lineup of top comedians to Noosa. Check The J's website for the exact date and remaining tickets, as it's likely happening this week.

events.title: Local Contemporary Art Prize Exhibition
events.description: A free exhibition showcasing 40 leading local artists from the Sunshine Coast, highlighting the region's diverse creative talent. Open Tuesday to Sunday throughout June at Caloundra Regional Gallery.

events.title: Noosa Regional Gallery: Exhibitions & Masterclass Series
events.description: Explore diverse contemporary exhibitions by local, national, and international artists at Noosa Regional Gallery. Also offers artist talks, workshops, and masterclasses, with bookings open for the 2026 series (check website for specific dates).

events.title: National Reconciliation Week Events
events.description: The final days of National Reconciliation Week (May 27 – June 3) offer opportunities to learn about shared histories, cultures, and achievements of First Nations people. Various free community events across the Sunshine Coast.

events.title: Noosa Gaff Rig Regatta
events.location: Noosa Yacht & Rowing Club, Noosa River
events.description: A spirited weekend of racing, tradition, and community on the Noosa River, bringing together classic rigs and sailing enthusiasts. Ideal for outdoor and adventure lovers with a genuine community atmosphere.

events.title: Sunshine Coast Libraries: Ongoing Programmes
events.description: Sunshine Coast Libraries offer a variety of free in-branch workshops, author talks, technology sessions, seed swapping, and book clubs. Check the website for specific daily listings at your local branch this week.
